hunt.justification: Protecting industrial refrigeration assets is a critical infrastructure priority; unauthorized manipulation can lead to significant inventory loss and food safety hazards.

stages.name: Exploitation and Authentication Bypass
observables: Authentication bypass attempts on management portals
Arbitrary code injection payloads in HTTP requests
Unauthorized access to controller web interfaces
Logons from unexpected source IPs to OT management consoles

stages.name: Manipulation of Thermal Settings
observables: Remote commands to alter temperature setpoints
Forced activation of heating or defrost cycles via management APIs
Loss of visibility into current temperature data (denial-of-view)
Configuration changes to temperature logging parameters

scenario.summary: Malicious actors are targeting industrial refrigeration and cold chain monitoring systems across the Healthcare, Food, and Transportation sectors by exploiting internet-exposed or unpatched electronic temperature controllers. Using authentication bypass and code injection, attackers remotely manipulate settings to trigger continuous heating or defrost cycles, leading to inventory loss, fire hazards, and loss of temperature visibility.

meta.rationale: Prioritize internet-exposed assets identified via external scanning before searching for behavioral anomalies in HTTP traffic.
meta.hypothesis: An adversary is targeting unpatched or internet-exposed industrial refrigeration controllers to bypass authentication and remotely manipulate thermal setpoints, potentially leading to equipment failure.

blind_spots.risk: Successful authentication bypass followed by raw OT protocol manipulation would not be visible in HTTP logs.
blind_spots.question: Whether manipulation occurred via non-HTTP industrial protocols once the perimeter was breached.
blind_spots.remediation: Deploy OT-aware IDS or enable protocol-level logging on OT gateways.

blind_spots.risk: Short-lived exposures might be missed by periodic third-party scans (Shodan/crt.sh).
blind_spots.question: Whether an asset was exposed and then removed between periodic scan intervals.
blind_spots.remediation: Increase scanning frequency for subnets hosting OT infrastructure.

hunt.name: Industrial Control System Exposure and Manipulation
hunt.description: This hunt identifies internet-accessible industrial refrigeration and cold-chain monitoring systems vulnerable to exploitation. It focuses on the discovery of exposed management panels via external scanning data, identifies rare or unauthorized access to management URI paths, and correlates these assets with known software vulnerabilities. The flow starts with an external exposure assessment, fans out to examine access prevalence and vulnerability status, and concludes with an agent-led triage of the risk factors.

nodes.label: Exposed controller panels via external scans

config.content: SELECT domain_or_ip, product, version, port, discovered_at FROM hb_exposed_assets WHERE (LOWER(product) LIKE '%refrigeration%' OR LOWER(product) LIKE '%temperature%' OR LOWER(product) LIKE '%emerson%' OR LOWER(product) LIKE '%carel%' OR LOWER(product) LIKE '%dixon%') AND discovered_at >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') AND '{{controller_keywords}}' != '' ORDER BY discovered_at DESC
config.description: Identify internet-facing industrial controllers matching reported product keywords, accounting for vendor suffixes.
config.expected_signal: A list of IP addresses or domains hosting known controller interfaces. Silence suggests no known exposed assets matching the keywords were detected recently.

primitive_config.label: Exposed controller panels via external scans

primitive_config.expected: A list of IP addresses or domains hosting known controller interfaces. Silence suggests no known exposed assets matching the keywords were detected recently.

nodes.label: Rare User-Agent access to management paths

config.content: SELECT user_agent, url_path, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) AS host_count, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_http_activity WHERE (LOWER(url_path) LIKE '/admin%' OR LOWER(url_path) LIKE '/config%' OR LOWER(url_path) LIKE '/setpoint%' OR LOWER(url_path) LIKE '/defrost%' OR LOWER(url_path) LIKE '/setup%') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') AND '{{management_paths}}' != '' GROUP BY user_agent, url_path HAVING host_count < 3 ORDER BY host_count ASC
config.description: Stack-count User-Agents accessing sensitive management URIs, including nested sub-directories, to find anomalies.
config.expected_signal: User-Agents seen on only one or two hosts accessing controller paths. Silence indicates only common, known User-Agents are accessing these paths.

primitive_config.label: Rare User-Agent access to management paths
primitive_config.content: SELECT user_agent, url_path, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) AS host_count, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_http_activity WHERE (LOWER(url_path) LIKE '/admin%' OR LOWER(url_path) LIKE '/config%' OR LOWER(url_path) LIKE '/setpoint%' OR LOWER(url_path) LIKE '/defrost%' OR LOWER(url_path) LIKE '/setup%') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') AND '{{management_paths}}' != '' GROUP BY user_agent, url_path HAVING host_count < 3 ORDER BY host_count ASC
primitive_config.expected: User-Agents seen on only one or two hosts accessing controller paths. Silence indicates only common, known User-Agents are accessing these paths.

config.content: SELECT d.hostname, v.cve_uid, v.severity, v.affected_package_name FROM hb_vulnerability_finding v JOIN hb_devices d ON v.device_uid = d.device_uid WHERE (LOWER(v.affected_package_name) LIKE '%refrigeration%' OR LOWER(v.affected_package_name) LIKE '%temperature%' OR LOWER(v.affected_package_name) LIKE '%emerson%' OR LOWER(v.affected_package_name) LIKE '%carel%' OR LOWER(v.affected_package_name) LIKE '%dixon%') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || d.hostname || ',') > 0) AND v.collected_at >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') AND '{{controller_keywords}}' != '' ORDER BY v.severity_id DESC
config.description: Cross-reference identified controller software with known CVEs by joining to device inventory for hostname context.
config.expected_signal: Vulnerability findings (CVEs) matching the controller keywords on relevant hosts. Matches prioritize hosts for behavioral review.

config.objective: Determine if the combination of internet exposure, known vulnerabilities, and rare User-Agent access indicates an active authentication bypass or configuration manipulation on industrial refrigeration systems. Correlate the external IP addresses or domains from exposed-controller-panels with the internal hostnames seen in hb_http_activity and hb_vulnerability_finding to identify if exposed systems are showing suspicious activity.
config.description: Weigh the findings from exposure, prevalence, and vulnerability queries to identify active exploitation.
config.expected_signal: A per-host verdict citing specific vulnerabilities and suspicious HTTP access patterns.
config.success_criteria: A per-host verdict of malicious, suspicious, or benign, supported by row citations.

config.question: the triage verdict is malicious for at least one host based on unauthorized access to a vulnerable controller interface
config.condition: the triage verdict is malicious for at least one host based on unauthorized access to a vulnerable controller interface
config.description: Direct high-confidence findings to containment while routing uncertain cases for analyst review.
Prevent further unauthorized manipulation by isolating the affected controller.

config.description: Review findings and coordinate with OT teams for long-term remediation.
config.instructions: Review the agent's cited rows. Verify if the access patterns match known exploit payloads. Coordinate with OT maintenance to check for abnormal defrost cycle logs on the physical unit.
